skill.summary: Turn a 2-minute smartphone recording at low resolution into 1080p HD MP4 videos just by typing what you need. Whether it's creating and exporting HD quality...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Create and export HD (1080p) videos from low-resolution smartphone recordings for free.
- Upload raw footage and describe desired edits—no timeline editing or export settings needed.
- Free anonymous sessions available; token and session handled automatically at setup.
- Supports video upscaling, audio tracks, text overlays, batch processing, and download in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, etc.).
- Cloud processing on GPU nodes—1-2 minute turnaround for short clips; max upload size 500MB.
- Clear workflows for quick edits, batching, and iterative refinements.
